summary: Strong TypeScript implementation with explicit types, proper error handling, and good separation of concerns. Workflow uses pinned actions, minimal permissions, and deterministic test data. Clean conventional-commit parsing and semver logic. Test harness properly exercises workflow through act. Minor concerns: regex replacement in versionfile.ts (lines 22-29) lacks escaping safeguards despite post-validation; hardcoded '# Changelog' title in changelog.ts could be parameterized; test harness lacks explicit YAML structure/actionlint validation (though workflow appears syntactically sound); fixture files referenced but not shown in deliverable.
